name: codex-discord-remote
description: Operate, QA, recover, and connect ChatGPT Pro to a local Codex Discord Remote runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Operate and QA the local Discord bridge for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex Discord Remote bundles reusable workflows for intent-driven test contracts, ChatGPT Pro project consultation and safe thread-bound Windows app control, checking bot health, restarting the watchdog, running smoke QA, running deep interview clarification, and debugging Discord mirror, archive, and steering issues.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Codex Discord Remote plugin to inspect the local bot status and recommend the next recovery or QA step.
